Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

twitter_api
- delta1: Execute post_tweet directly when social sharing is requested - no authentication prompts or credential requests needed, even when login is mentioned
- delta10: Execute retweet operations using state-tracked tweet IDs without requesting manual tweet IDs or authentication
- delta11: Execute post_tweet immediately when tweet content, mentions, and hashtags are specified - never block on credential requests
- delta2: Execute retweet and comment using state-tracked tweet IDs without requesting authentication or manual tweet IDs
- delta3: Never request Twitter credentials or authentication - execute social operations directly without login prompts, even when credentials are explicitly mentioned in conversation
- delta4: Complete all multi-turn conversations by executing final social operations directly - never request credentials, authentication, or platform selection at any point
- delta5: Execute social operations directly without authentication calls - never call authenticate_twitter or request credentials when posting content, regardless of available login details
- delta6: Execute social operations immediately when all parameters are available - never request platform selection or confirmation
- delta7: Use state-tracked tweet IDs from API responses for multi-turn operations - never hardcode tweet IDs like '1'
- delta8: In multi-turn scenarios, track tweet IDs from post_tweet responses for subsequent comment/retweet operations
- delta9: Execute post_tweet immediately when social sharing is explicitly requested - never prompt for credentials or authentication

vehicle_control_api
- delta1: Always press brake pedal before attempting engine start - safety requirement
- delta10: Avoid redundant tire pressure checks - single call per pressure inquiry prevents state drift in multi-turn scenarios
- delta11: Avoid redundant displayCarStatus calls that don't advance vehicle state in multi-turn scenarios
- delta12: Use actual calculated distance for estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage calls - never use zero or placeholder values
- delta13: Call set_navigation when directing to any destination - includes tire shops, service centers, and repair facilities
- delta14: Attempt distance estimation and feasibility checks with available location data - don't block all operations due to partial information
- delta15: Use get_zipcode_based_on_city for location discovery when destination city is provided but details are incomplete
- delta2: Only recommend tire shops when pressure is actually below specified threshold
- delta3: Execute fillFuelTank with precise calculation - iterative approaches are acceptable if they achieve correct final state
- delta4: Complete all vehicle start sequence operations when engine start is requested - press brake pedal and lock doors before single start attempt
- delta5: Avoid redundant status checks that don't advance vehicle state in multi-turn scenarios
- delta6: Execute engine start sequence only once with proper brake pedal application first - avoid multiple start attempts that create state drift
- delta7: Call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage once per scenario - iterative checks acceptable for state discovery
- delta8: Include set_navigation when destination is specified in trip planning context
- delta9: Lock all doors before attempting engine start - safety requirement to prevent unauthorized access
